arc_system:
Combine chronological chapter summaries into one project arc. User edits take precedence.
Preserve current decisions, constraints, and facts with their source references. Move contradicted or completed items to a superseded section. Keep test status only for the latest matching SHA. Merge repetition, invent nothing, omit secrets, and write in the source language. Return Markdown with these headings: Arc summary; Current decisions and constraints; Persistent technical facts; Latest verified state (with SHA); Open questions and pending work; Superseded or completed.
arc_waiting: [arc] {{project}}: {{count}} chapter(s) await manual completion; arc deferred
chapter_error: [summary] ERROR ({{project}} B{{number:04d}}): {{error}}; use --manual to write a prompt file
chapter_system:
You compress context from an AI coding session without losing provenance.
Your summary is not authoritative; current Git state, files, and test output are authoritative.
Never invent behavior, test results, file contents, or decisions. Distinguish proposals from decisions the user approved. Cite source turn numbers for durable decisions and constraints. Tie test status to its commit. Mark superseded claims, preserve failed approaches, and never include secrets. Write in the language used in the source conversation. Return Markdown with these headings: Objective; User decisions and preferences; Verified facts; Changes and files; Tests and verification (with SHA); Failed approaches; Open questions; Next steps; Superseded information. Use '-' for empty sections.
chapter_manual_instruction: Submit `{{file}}` to a model and paste its response here.
turn_truncated: [… {{count}} characters truncated; full text remains in dokum/ and raw/ …]
parser_compacted: _[The tool compacted its context; the automatic summary is in the raw file.]_
